hotspots.title: AfD’s poll surge and leadership ambitions
hotspots.blurb: The far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) has reached a record 29% in German polls, leading the conservative Union by 7 points. Interior ministers warn of security risks if AfD forms a government in Saxony-Anhalt, citing ties to extremist groups and foreign states. AfD’s 94-page election program proposes radical policies like a 'deportation police' and stricter migration controls.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to the alarming rise of a far-right party in Germany, raising concerns about democratic stability and security risks.
